title: PC-12 NGX Operator Path (3 Weeks)
description: A focused operator track for the Pilatus PC-12 NGX covering systems orientation, startup discipline, and practical IFR workflow.

lessons.title: Airframe + PT6 Systems Orientation
lessons.objective: Understand the PC-12 NGX platform, PT6 engine fundamentals, and cockpit layout before engine start.

lessons.title: Primus Apex + Startup Workflow
lessons.objective: Go from cold & dark to a stable pre-taxi state with repeatable flows and avionics setup.

lessons.title: IFR Planning + Departure Execution
lessons.objective: Apply route setup, automation prep, and departure management in a practical IFR mission.
